stories.title: 49ers' Pearsall to have season-ending surgery
stories.summary: San Francisco 49ers wide receiver Ricky Pearsall is expected to have surgery on the nagging PCL injury that dates back to last season and will be out for the year, general manager John Lynch told reporters.

stories.title: Sources: Pirates take shot, trade for Yanks' Doval
stories.summary: Seeking bullpen help in their quest to end an 11-year postseason drought, the Pirates have agreed to a trade for Yankees reliever Camilo Doval, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Bills' Gardner-Johnson carted off with leg injury
stories.summary: Bills safety C.J. Gardner-Johnson was carted to the locker room after suffering a lower-body injury during Saturday's training camp practice.

stories.title: Chiefs rookie standout Allen, Worthy injured
stories.summary: Chiefs wide receiver Cyrus Allen sustained a shin bruise during a special teams drill, a source said, while fellow receiver Xavier Worthy also left the field early because of a shoulder injury.

stories.title: Bears' Johnson: 2026 'definitely a contract year'
stories.summary: Bears cornerback Jaylon Johnson is approaching the 2026 season with his sights set on another payday.
